alignment.label: bullish hits iff D close > T close; risk hits iff D close < T close; flat is a miss
alignment.origin_date: candidate computed using data visible through T
alignment.target_date: next tradable stock row after T; suspension rows are skipped and target OHLCV is outcome-only

limitations: Adjusted local research data and current-file survivorship remain limitations.
